acceptance_predicates.description: The strict-state failure is reproduced on the exact current base and classified as pre-existing.
The required typed coordinator adapter and role modules are present, correctly packaged, and imported by handoffctl without exclusions.
Formatting, mypy, doctor, render-status, AWQ, DCO, and signature checks pass at the exact repair head.
Only coordination quality is changed; product behavior and development-only nonblocking semantics remain unchanged.

definition_of_done: The strict state workflow is green on the exact repair head.
Independent review confirms no suppression, exclusion, or gate weakening.

inputs.description: Hosted strict-state failure and exact-base reproduction receipt.

outputs.description: Exact-head baseline/repair evidence and hosted checks.

gates.description: The complete Git-backed state verification workflow passes without new exclusions or suppressed errors.
